name: Sopris Run-Off
description: Incredible point to point course, highly recommend. One wrong turn, one stop to check the map and one head over heels downhill tumble. Not nearly as fit as I was last year but I’m very happy to be able to finish this distance pain free. Really lost gas on the last climb and lost a lot of time there, which makes sense I guess as this was my longest run in 8 months yikes. Good re-entry to racing - staved off side stitches, calf cramps - classics.
